text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Ah... you there.
Would you be so kind as to borrow the art room key for me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Turning around, I saw Mejiro Ramonu gazing at
a horse girl with a surprised look on her face.
choice_data_list: (I thought she was talking to me...)

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: M-Me? Why...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: The faculty room is in the opposite direction, is it not? From the art room.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not what I mean... Why me?
Something like that... g-go get it yourself!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Oh, is that so.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What was that all of a sudden...!
Are you mocking me?
Just because you're famous...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
What's up, what happened?
If you want, tell me about it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I just passed by Ramonu-sama a moment ago~.
Did something happen~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I get it now. Sorry if she offended you!
I'll apologize on behalf of the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Indeed~, that is simply how she is~.
I am sure she meant no harm—

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean 'how she is'?! Ordering people around like that...!
I knew it... I won't be satisfied
until I give her a piece of my mind!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there she goes!
This is bad, let's split up and look for her!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While running around the campus on my own, I found
the horse girl from earlier and Mejiro Ramonu outside the art room.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Like I said, what you did earlier was rude!
If you think everyone's just going to obey your orders,
you've got another thing coming!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: If you do not wish to, you do not wish to.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...That is quite enough, is it not?
Does that not conclude the matter?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Mejiro Ramonu had not forced anything.
Once refused, she had backed off without a fuss.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Y-Your attitude is the problem!
In the end, you went and got the key yourself anyway, right?!
Then from the very start... Ah, ...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Paying no mind, Mejiro Ramonu carried an oil painting
out from the art room. It was a dark, abstract piece.
It seemed strangely unpolished, though...?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
...? What's that?
This signature... Huh, you painted this.
Such muddy colors. You're not even that good, are you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Indeed. It is a painting from my elementary school days, after all.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: Huh! A-Ah, I see... Hmph...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I brought it over thinking I would touch it up.
However, my brush wouldn't move... so I came to retrieve it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: You possess quite a discerning eye.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: Wh-Why, you...! Making a fool out of me to the very end... Fine, whatever!

She dashed away, her face burning bright red.
Whether it was anger at her malice failing to land, vexation,
or perhaps an even more complicated emotion, one couldn't tell.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: My, what a splendid start she makes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Th-There you are~~~! Hey,
wasn't that girl from earlier just running past...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
She looked quite huffy, you know~
Are both of you all right~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: She was merely playing around.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: If she wished to bite, she should have done so upon the turf.

Even as she said that, Mejiro Ramonu's expression
quickly settled into indifference.
choice_data_list: That girl must be intensely conscious of you.
That girl must be intensely conscious of you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Is that so...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Ah... In that case, perhaps I should offer her a proper greeting next time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: To fan the sparks into a flame... so that those legs turn toward me.
